messages:
Priya Nair: Heads-up team — Mosaic QBR next Thu 9am PT. Need a compact deck: onboarding progress, health signal, renewal risk, and a 5-min demo. Who picks what?
Ethan Cole: Ill take onboarding status. Will pull success rate, stuck flows, and release notes impact. ETA Tue EOD.
Rosa Martinez: Ill own the renewal signal slide. Plan: single slide with traffic trend, support queue delta, and risk level.
Liam O'Connor: Ill prep the demo cadence + short fallback script. Keep demo <5 mins.
Priya Nair: Also include a one-paragraph customer sentiment snapshot (last 30 days). Execs asked for a top quote + NPS-like stat.
Ethan Cole: Quick SQL Im running to get issue counts:
SELECT severity, count(*) FROM onboarding_events WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY severity;
qbr-bot: Reminder set — slide freeze Wed 6pm PT.
Rosa Martinez: Ill add a proposed mitigation package if risk >= medium (dedicated onboarding hours + 10% credit).
Priya Nair: Owners recap: Ethan = onboarding + feedback, Rosa = renewal signal + mitigations, Liam = demo + fallback. Ill collate slides and run the rehearsal Wed 11am PT.
Liam O'Connor: Scheduling note: can we get the latest billing extract linked in the doc so I can compute cost-per-active?
Priya Nair: Uploaded to the shared doc: https://redwood-internal.docs/qbr/mosaic. See appendix for raw exports.
qbr-bot: Event created: "Mosaic QBR dry run" Wed 11:00-11:15 PT — attendees: Priya, Ethan, Rosa, Liam.
